mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: It is a mixture because you can see two colours.

intelligence.enrichment: In a uniform mixture, the components are mixed so evenly that they cannot be seen separately even with a microscope; in a non-uniform mixture, the different components or uneven distribution can be observed. The way components are distributed determines whether the mixture appears the same throughout or shows separate parts. The learner correctly applies this rule: In a uniform mixture, the components are mixed so evenly that they cannot be seen separately even with a microscope; in a non-uniform mixture, the different components or uneven distribution can be observed. A mixture with more than one substance must be non-uniform because different substances are present.
